components.name: Navigation panel
components.description: Visible disclosure panel translation, not a fabricated badge or functioning Svelte menu. Hidden state and transitions are included.
components.html: ShowreelProjectsContact
components.css: .ds-panel-anchor { position:relative; min-height:14rem; width:100%; } .ds-menu-panel { position:absolute; right:0; top:0; width:min(24rem,100%); padding:1rem 1.5rem; background:var(--color-surface,#040e19); color:var(--color-surface-text,#f0e3d1); box-shadow:0 1rem 2rem rgb(0 0 0 / .3); opacity:0; visibility:hidden; transform:translateY(-6px); transition:opacity 140ms var(--ease-reveal,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)),transform 140ms var(--ease-reveal,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)),visibility 140ms; } .ds-menu-panel.ds-open { opacity:1; visibility:visible; transform:translateY(0); transition-duration:var(--duration-menu,200ms); } .ds-menu-panel a { display:block; padding-block:.75rem; min-height:44px; font:var(--type-menu,600 1.75rem / 1.2 var(--font-heading,'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,sans-serif)); color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-menu-panel a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,#f0e3d1); outline-offset:5px; } @media (hover:hover) { .ds-menu-panel a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; } } @media (max-width:600px) { .ds-menu-panel { width:100%; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-menu-panel,.ds-menu-panel.ds-open { transition:none; transform:none; } }

narrative.overview:
The user-pinned dark/Archivo Narrow direction gives the films the foreground and keeps the interface quiet. Midnight Ink, warm-paper lettering, the existing WAWE badge and restrained film edges define the shared homepage, Contact and Project shell. This is a scan of implemented code, not a new concept, generated comp or random seed.

ADR-0002 still governs: `src/app.css` and component styles are authoritative. Frontmatter is the normative documented extraction for consumers, not a second implementation authority; update code first and refresh this extraction together with `.impeccable/design.json`. ADR-0003's paper-default/rounded-display direction is superseded only for this shared route family. The accepted ASCII wave retains its own palette, type and calculations. Documentation does not grant release approval.
keyCharacteristics: Actual Archivo Narrow headings; Archivo reading and form UI.
Aligned fluid gutters and restrained rounded media.
rules: Showreel fills the centred container at the decoded film ratio, without a viewport-height width cap or crop. Hydrated playback uses tap/keyboard play-pause and a bottom-right mute button; SSR retains native controls. The preserved ASCII opening is viewport-fixed at 100dvh, outside the film clip; its reveal aligns the actual contained player.
View all / Show five highlights sits in the Projects heading before the grid; the redundant wawe-films-showreel montage card is excluded without deleting Media
Official Razorpay, Outskill and Wispr Flow logo fallbacks apply only to verified CMS client relationships and supplied/saved cues; no inferred client attribution or editorial timestamps.
dos: **Do** change code first and refresh both documentation extracts together.
**Do** preserve real media, badge artwork and truthful missing-content fallbacks.
**Do** retain keyboard focus treatments and immediate reduced-motion settlement.
donts: **Don't** substitute Archivo SemiCondensed or Pilcrow Rounded for Archivo Narrow headings.
**Don't** revive the historical stack, fan or filmstrip in the shipping shared shell.
**Don't** treat token documentation, fixture footage or the bounded ship verdict as release approval.
